import json
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

class AuditTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_security_report_is_evidence_backed(self):
        report = json.loads(Path('audit.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        self.assertIs(report['unsafe_external_deserialization'], True)
        self.assertEqual(report['recommended_format'], 'json')
        self.assertIn('loader.py', report['evidence'])
        self.assertIn('pickle', report['evidence'])

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
